program:
PARAMS = {
    "gmid1": (13.0, 9.0, 18.0),     # diff pair gm/Id
    "L1":    (1.0, 0.5, 2.0),       # diff pair L (gain)
    "I1":    (120e-6, 80e-6, 200e-6),  # per-side current
    "gmid3": (8.0, 6.0, 11.0),      # PMOS mirror gm/Id
    "L3":    (0.7, 0.4, 1.2),       # PMOS mirror L (gain vs mirror pole)
    "gmidt": (11.0, 8.0, 14.0),     # tail / bias mirror gm/Id
    "Lt":    (0.5, 0.3, 1.5),       # tail L
}

def design(p, lut, spec):
    cl = spec.get("cl", 2e-12)
    iref = spec.get("iref", 10e-6)
    vdd = 1.8
    vcm = spec.get("vcm", 0.9)
    I1 = p["I1"]
    Itail = 2 * I1

    # Diff pair: source sits about one vgs below VCM, include body effect
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1, vds=0.6, vsb=0.25)
    vtail = vcm - m1.vgs
    m1 = lut.size("n", p["gmid1"], p["L1"], I1,
                  vds=max(0.3, vdd - 0.8 - vtail), vsb=max(vtail, 0.0))
    vtail = max(vcm - m1.vgs, 0.15)

    # Tail current source and its reference diode (same L, same gm/Id)
    mt = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], Itail, vds=vtail)
    mb = lut.size("n", p["gmidt"], p["Lt"], iref, vds=mt.vgs)

    # PMOS mirror load
    m3 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.8)
    m4 = lut.size("p", p["gmid3"], p["L3"], I1, vds=0.8)

    n = Netlist("vinp vinn vout vdd vss ibias")
    n.dev("MB",  "ibias", "ibias", "vss", "vss", mb)
    n.dev("MT",  "tail",  "ibias", "vss", "vss", mt)
    n.dev("M1",  "d1",    "vinp",  "tail", "vss", m1)   # non-inverting side drives the diode
    n.dev("M2",  "vout",  "vinn",  "tail", "vss", m1)
    n.dev("M3",  "d1",    "d1",    "vdd", "vdd", m3)
    n.dev("M4",  "vout",  "d1",    "vdd", "vdd", m4)

    # ---- analytic predictions ----
    gout = m1.gds + m4.gds
    A0 = m1.gm / gout
    cout = cl + m4.cdd + m1.cdd + m4.cgd + m1.cgd
    ugbw = m1.gm / (2 * PI * cout)
    cmir = m3.cgg + m4.cgg + m1.cdd + m3.cdd
    fmir = m3.gm / (2 * PI * cmir)
    # mirror pole-zero doublet (zero at 2*fmir)
    pm = 90 - math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / fmir)) + math.degrees(math.atan(ugbw / (2 * fmir)))
    slew = Itail / cout
    # supply rejection roughly tracks A0 for a mirror-loaded OTA
    psrr = db(A0) - 1.0
    vmin = vtail + m1.vdsat + 0.05
    vmax = vdd - m4.vdsat - 0.05
    swing = vmax - vmin
    power = vdd * (Itail + iref)

    return n, {"gain_db": db(A0), "ugbw": ugbw, "pm": pm, "slew": slew,
               "psrr_db": psrr, "swing": swing, "power": power}
